title: Anchorless stratified micro-bundle sampler for quantization calibration and validation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem statement: We need a reproducible, lightweight sampling pipeline that constructs per-domain calibration bundles for INT8/FP8 quant profiles from prod prompts. Existing pack generators are heavy, too coupled to tenant anchors, and create brittle holdouts for accuracy validation. This ticket designs and implements an 'anchorless stratified micro-bundle' sampler that produces small (200-2k example) validation bundles per domain with preserved context windows, balanced token-length distribution, temporal bucketing, and adversarial/noise filtering. Goals: 1) Produce domain-aligned calibration bundles that reflect live distribution and edge tails (very long contexts, multi-turn dialogs). 2) Ensure bundles include deterministic holdouts for cross-run accuracy comparisons for INT8/FP8 profiles. 3) Respect privacy and PII rules (anonymization/PII heuristics) and tenant isolation where required. 4) Provide a fast, repeatable pipeline that can run daily and tag bundles with metadata needed by evaluation jobs (seed, sampling-hash, time-range, domain, token-length-buckets).
acceptance_criteria: Sampler produces per-domain bundles with configurable size and token-length bucket targets
Holdout set generation is deterministic given seed and sampling-hash and can be reproduced across runs
Bundles show <=3% drift in top-5 token distribution vs production baseline when sampling is disabled (sanity check)
Integration tests validate anonymization heuristics (no raw email/phone tokens in output bundles) and tenant isolation flags work
Evaluation jobs for INT8 and FP8 run using these bundles and produce pass/fail artifacts and metrics (WER-like / token-accuracy / end-to-end LM loss deltas)
tasks: Design sampling spec and config schema (domains, size, buckets, recency weights, collision rules)
Implement streaming sampler that reads daily prompt logs, computes features (token_count, turns, is_dialog, tenant_hash), applies filters and stratified reservoir sampling
Add adversarial/noise detection stage (duplicate detection, injection heuristics, excessive-system-commands filter)
Implement deterministic holdout selection and manifest format (jsonl with metadata header)
Add PII anonymization pass and verify with privacy tests
Expose CLI and a lightweight HTTP endpoint for manual bundle generation and status
Dashboard: add per-domain bundle health metrics to Console (coverage, token distribution, sample entropy)
Write integration tests and evaluation job wiring for runtime automated INT8/FP8 validation runs
notes_and_decisions: Decision: avoid tenant 'anchor' exemplars to improve generalization; instead use tenant_hash for optional stratification when privacy flags present
Decision: use a two-pass approach — light-weight streaming pass to compute candidate weights then deterministic reservoir draw with fixed RNG seed to guarantee reproducible holdouts
Trade-off: aggressive deduplication reduces attack surface but may underrepresent legitimate repeated flows; tuned dedupe to 3 duplicates per 24h window
Edge-case: very long contexts (>32k tokens) will be clipped into overlapping context shards with shard metadata to preserve KV-cache behavior during quant validation
Privacy: anonymization uses reversible per-run pseudonyms stored only in customer KMS-protected store when customer opt-in; otherwise strict redaction
metrics_and_monitoring: Token-length distribution alignment score vs production (KL-divergence)
Anonymization failure rate (detected PII in bundle)
Downstream quant-eval delta: avg token-loss change INT8/FP8 vs fp16 baseline
rollout_plan: Week 0: land sampler core and unit tests on staging; run nightly on sampled domains (internal only)
Week 1: enable PII checks and privacy tests, wire evaluation jobs for INT8/FP8 with synthetic models
Week 2: run side-by-side comparison against current calibration packs on 10 production domains, collect metrics
Week 3: iterate on filters and bucket targets based on KL and loss deltas; enable per-tenant stratification opt-in
Week 4: promote to daily runs and add Console health panels and alerts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: sampler under-samples rare tail prompts -> mitigation: add an explicit tail-sampling boost via rarity score
Risk: anonymization false-negatives -> mitigation: automated PII unit tests and manual spot checks; block release if failure rate >0.1%
Risk: holdout drift across runs due to log schema changes -> mitigation: normalizer layer with schema-validation and fallback mapping rules
Risk: privacy leakage via metadata (timestamps/tenant patterns) -> mitigation: allow coarse-grained time bucketing and tenant_hash salting
